item.title: SEC Charges Investment Adviser with Misleading Investors About Fees
item.description: The SEC alleges the adviser overbilled clients by $12 million over five years.

item.title: SEC Adopts Amendments to Form 10-K Climate Disclosure Requirements
item.description: The amendments simplify reporting for smaller filers.

item.title: SEC Obtains Final Judgment Against Former Crypto Lending Executive
item.description: The court ordered disgorgement and a permanent officer-and-director bar.

item.title: Statement on Proposed Changes to Quarterly Reporting
item.description: Commissioner remarks on whether the SEC should allow semiannual reports.

item.title: SEC Announces Agenda for Investor Advisory Committee Meeting
item.description: The SEC committee will discuss retail access to private markets.

item.title: SEC Charges Software Company and Executives in Revenue Recognition Scheme
item.description: The SEC alleges the company pulled forward revenue to meet analyst estimates.

item.title: SEC Announces Enforcement Results for Fiscal Year 2026
item.description: The SEC filed 612 enforcement actions and obtained $4.1 billion in remedies.

item.title: SEC Charges Nimbus Lending and Founder Mark Ellery With Defrauding Retail Crypto Investors
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission charged crypto lending platform Nimbus Lending and its founder Mark Ellery with a $1.2 billion fraud on retail investors.

item.title: SEC Charges Former Hedge Fund Analyst With Insider Trading Ahead of Merger
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission charged a former hedge fund analyst with insider trading ahead of a pharmaceutical merger announcement.
